ns2:course.label: Vapor Phase Thin Film Growth
ns2:course.description: A description of atomic level processes occurring during vapor phase film growth. Quantitative consideration of growth mechanisms and microstructure evolution of films based on experimental results from atomic level probes, modeling and simulation. Prerequisite: MSE 500; MSE 501; PHYS 460 or PHYS 560. Recommended: MSE 582 or CHBE 553.
